text: {"frames":["Edith, the learned owl from the mill, sat on the bell rope of the drowned village and would not let go. The bell had tolled through the fog all night, and the water on the lowest church step had crept higher. On the slate by the door someone had chalked one fraction: {x}. Edith tapped it with her beak and looked at you as if you should already know what it meant. What is {x} as a percentage?","A jar of fog knocked against your boot, and Gareth, the girl who collects fog, caught it before it rolled into the canal. She showed you the dyke log, where the watchman had written that the sluice stood open by {x}. Nobody had seen the watchman by day, and the log was in his hand, though the ink was still wet. Gareth held the jar up to the light and said the fog would tell nothing until the sluice was measured. How many percent is {x}?","Somebody has been lighting the lamps again, said the baker's boy, pointing at the house with the hoist beam. Every window glowed, yet the house was empty, and the front door stood open on a cold step. You counted the windows on the list pinned by the door, and the list said the lamps were lit by {x} of the glass. The boy wanted to know whether the house was asleep or only pretending. What percentage of the windows is {x}?","Nell, the boy with the blue lantern, lifted it high at the foot of the Tower clock. The clock had just struck an hour that does not exist, and the hands had not moved since. On the dial a painted line showed how far the day had run, and it stopped at {x} of the way round. The lantern flickered, as if the clock was waiting for an answer. What is {x} written as a percentage?","Please, help me, said Luuk, the old lock keeper, and he held the book open with both hands. The book kept writing by itself, slowly, in a neat round hand that was not his. The last line said the gate would close when {x} of the tide had gone out, and the canal was already falling. Luuk wanted to know how much of the tide that was, before the gate shut for good. What percentage is {x}?"]}
